Description: A client-facing dashboard rollout project for Windrow, currently in design review with client sign-off on chart layouts.

# Windrow Dashboard Rollout

Windrow Dashboard Rollout is an active client project involving the design and delivery of a dashboard, including chart layouts and an accompanying user guide.[^1] During a design review, Priya Anand presented revised chart layouts to client stakeholders, who signed off on all three.[^1] A user guide for the dashboard is being updated and was to be proofed by a print vendor ahead of a training session scheduled for the following week.[^1]

## Open Questions
- [ ] What is the full scope and timeline of the Windrow Dashboard Rollout project beyond the design review and training session?
- [ ] Who are the client stakeholders involved, and what organization does Priya Anand represent?
- [ ] What is the identity and role of the print vendor in this project?

[^1]: sessions/2026-04-15.md
